overview.description: The Roundhill S&P 500 Target 20 Managed Distribution ETF (XPAY) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund is an actively managed fund, whose primary objective is to pay a monthly return of capital distribution at an annualized rate of twenty percent, while providing exposure to the S&P 500 Index. The fund uses predominately FLEX call options to pursue this strategy. XPAY was launched on Oct 31, 2024 and is issued by Roundhill.
